about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a responsible person who tries to treat everyone politely and respectfully. I'm full of curiosity and willingness to learn, used to working in teams but able to make progress on my own.
about.p2: Lately I've become fascinated by how AI is reshaping software development, and I've been building structured workflows to integrate it reliably into real projects.

meme.title: Swap your face
meme.intro: Search Giphy, pick a GIF and wear it on the home page. It's a tiny demo of how this site handles data and state.

how.title: How it works
steps: Search for a meme using any word — cat, monday, whatever you like.
Pick your favorite from the results.
Your photo on the home page turns into that meme.
Reload the page whenever you want your real photo back.

results.error: Try again in a moment or with another word.
results.badQuery: That search isn't valid: use 1 to 50 plain characters.
results.notConfigured: Meme mode isn't configured on this server yet.

meme.success: Done! Your new face is live on the home page.
